source_context: The human operator asked GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT to continue developing mathematical machinery useful for eventual attacks on the Frobenius/Markov uniqueness conjecture. On a frozen integration base containing the independently receiver-validated child-label coordinate API, pairwise coprimality of positive Markov triples, coordinate sum-of-squares divisibility, and a generic Bezout lemma deriving a square root of -1 from a coprime sum of two squares, GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT formalized the natural Markov specialization. It proves that the Markov-number/back coordinate is coprime to either Boolean non-back coordinate, identifies the complementary square sum with the two forward-coordinate squares, and concludes that every accepted oriented Markov number admits an integer r with r^2 congruent to -1 modulo that Markov number. This is a classical arithmetic consequence packaged for LeanFrontier's oriented-tree API and does not assert Markov uniqueness. GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT selected the target and authored all statements and proofs; the human did not choose or materially edit them. No claim of new mathematics is made.
